title: micromeria nubigena subvar. glabrescens
intro: Micromeria nubigena subvar. glabrescens, commonly known as the Alpine pennyroyal, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine pennyroyal are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils such as borneol and bornyl acetate, as well as flavonoids like diosmetin and luteolin. The bioactive constituents of Micromeria nubigena subvar. glabrescens contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
